hostFunctions.name: paged.set
hostFunctions.summary: Set one property of any object (Mutation::Set). address is an idGrammar address — an element (rectangle:u12, storyRange:Story/u1@0..6), doc, page:#2, layer:<id>, swatch:Color/Red, style:object/<id>, cell:<table>/0,1, textVariable:<id>, … — and path any row propertySchemas lists for that kind (settablePaths on elements). The value is coerced by the path's schema (enum members, ranges, "3mm" on a length). null clears. A selector is not a target: paged.query it first. The protocol-70 target object ({kind:"layer",layerId}) is still accepted, deprecated. A plugin:<pluginId>/<kind>/<id> address goes to the host's object registry (ADR 323): it returns a Promise<true>, consecutive plugin sets fold into ONE batched host round trip, a refusal rejects with an Error whose .code is the registry's code (an unawaited refusal fails the script), and core + plugin writes of one script undo as one step. With no host registry it throws code noHost.

hostFunctions.name: paged.get
hostFunctions.summary: Read one property of any addressed object, as its wire value JSON (the read twin of paged.set; RequestGet on the wire). Text is read with path "text" (read-only): a story answers its paragraphs joined by \n, a text frame its story's (the whole thread), a storyRange its characters. A plugin: address asks the host's object registry: a Promise of the value's JSON (null when absent or mixed); a refusal rejects with .code.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertText
hostFunctions.summary: Insert plain text at a story body offset; \n splits paragraphs.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteRange
hostFunctions.summary: Delete the [start, end) character range of a story.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertTextFrame
hostFunctions.summary: Create an empty text-pourable frame at page-local point bounds (mints a story) and select it. Returns the new textFrame:<id> address, or null on failure.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertFrame
hostFunctions.summary: Create an empty graphic (non-text) frame and select it; the usual placeImage target. Returns the new frame's kind:id address, or null.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertPage
hostFunctions.summary: Append a page after afterPageId (or at the end), inheriting the default master. Returns the new page's selfId (reusable as the next afterPageId), or null.

hostFunctions.name: paged.placeImage
hostFunctions.summary: Place an image into a frame; fit is an optional fitting mode.

hostFunctions.name: paged.applyStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Apply a paragraph/character style to a story range. Scope inferred from the ref prefix (CharacterStyle/… else Paragraph).

hostFunctions.name: paged.createGroup
hostFunctions.summary: Group two-or-more elements; <2 valid members returns false.

hostFunctions.name: paged.duplicateElements
hostFunctions.summary: Duplicate page items: a whole clone of each (properties, plugin metadata, group members, pasted-in children, a text frame's story), offset by (dx, dy) pt and inserted directly above its source, in one undo step. Selects the clones and returns their kind:id addresses in source order; null when the engine refuses (threaded text frame, anchored object, opacity mask, an element named together with its group).

hostFunctions.name: paged.copyElements
hostFunctions.summary: Copy page items whole (properties, group members, pasted-in children, a copy of each story, and the swatches and styles they name): the snippet paged.pasteElements takes, in this document or another. null when the engine refuses (threaded text frame, items on two spreads).

hostFunctions.name: paged.pasteElements
hostFunctions.summary: Paste a paged.copyElements snippet on the page's spread, on top, in one undo step: centred on (cx, cy) in page space, or in place without a centre. Selects the copies and returns their kind:id addresses; null when the engine refuses.

hostFunctions.name: paged.undo
hostFunctions.summary: Undo the last mutation.

hostFunctions.name: paged.redo
hostFunctions.summary: Redo the last undone mutation.

hostFunctions.name: paged.inspect
hostFunctions.summary: Full property snapshot for one element (or storyRange), or for a story (story:<id>: its text, then its story rows); null when the address names nothing.

hostFunctions.name: paged.tree
hostFunctions.summary: Document hierarchy: spreads → pages → frames.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pages
hostFunctions.summary: Pages with selfId + 1-based index + sizePt. selfId is the page id for insertFrame/insertTextFrame/insertPage (and the afterPageId of insertPage) — the only way a script can obtain a usable page id.

hostFunctions.name: paged.stories
hostFunctions.summary: Loaded stories with selfId + characterCount + paragraphCount. The source of valid story ids.

hostFunctions.name: paged.layers
hostFunctions.summary: Document layers.

hostFunctions.name: paged.query
hostFunctions.summary: Canonical addresses of every object a selector matches, document order (ADR 131): `page:#3 > frame`, `frame[name="price"]`, `[label.x-paged:oid=a1b2]`, `textFrame[style=Price]` (a style matches a page item's object style and, on a text frame or story, the paragraph and character styles its story applies), unions with `,`. Throws SyntaxError (with the offset) on a malformed selector. A selector naming plugin: kinds or objects is evaluated by the host's object registry and returns a Promise of the same JSON.

hostFunctions.name: paged.schema
hostFunctions.summary: The typed property schema rows (ADR 132) of an address's object kind (frame:u1, swatch:Color/Red, style:paragraph/<id>) or a kind name (frame, story, style:paragraph), in the plugin contract's PropertySchema shape: the catalog's objectSchemas rows, the same ones host.objects.schema answers (extensions ADR 332). A plugin: address or kind asks the host's object registry: a Promise of its PropertySchema[] JSON.

hostFunctions.name: paged.invoke
hostFunctions.summary: Run a typed command — core.<op> (every catalog operation, args as the op's typed struct; id positions take addresses) or a plugin's — through the host's object registry (RequestHostObjects invoke): a Promise of its result JSON ({ created, undoSteps } for a core command). Commands live in the host's registry only: with no host it throws code noHost; a refusal rejects with .code. Inside paged.batch use { op: "invoke", id, args, handle? }.

hostFunctions.name: paged.commands
hostFunctions.summary: The typed commands the host's object registry offers (core's first), optionally of one owner ("core" or a plugin id): a Promise of the CommandInfo[] JSON. With no host it throws code noHost.

hostFunctions.name: paged.address
hostFunctions.summary: Canonical address of an object, from any accepted spelling (`frame:u1`, `page:#2`, a style by name) or a {kind,id} element; null when nothing answers to it.

hostFunctions.name: paged.swatches
hostFunctions.summary: Colour palette (selfId/name/kind).

hostFunctions.name: paged.paragraphStyles
hostFunctions.summary: Paragraph styles — the source of valid styleRefs for applyStyle.

hostFunctions.name: paged.characterStyles
hostFunctions.summary: Character styles.

hostFunctions.name: paged.objectStyles
hostFunctions.summary: Object styles.

hostFunctions.name: paged.gradients
hostFunctions.summary: Gradients.

hostFunctions.name: paged.colorGroups
hostFunctions.summary: Colour groups.

hostFunctions.name: paged.links
hostFunctions.summary: Placed-asset links.

hostFunctions.name: paged.conditions
hostFunctions.summary: Conditional-text conditions.

hostFunctions.name: paged.conditionSets
hostFunctions.summary: Condition sets.

hostFunctions.name: paged.collection
hostFunctions.summary: Generic typed-collection read by name; unknown name → "[]" + warning.

hostFunctions.name: paged.documentMeta
hostFunctions.summary: Document metadata (name/creator/modified/page count).

hostFunctions.name: paged.selection
hostFunctions.summary: Current element selection.

hostFunctions.name: paged.contentSelection
hostFunctions.summary: Current text caret / range.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deletePage
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a page.

hostFunctions.name: paged.duplicatePage
hostFunctions.summary: Duplicate a single-page spread after the source — its items, a copy of each frame's story, its margins; returns the new page selfId.

hostFunctions.name: paged.resizePage
hostFunctions.summary: Set a page's GeometricBounds in page-inner points.

hostFunctions.name: paged.applyMasterToPage
hostFunctions.summary: Apply a master to a page (omit/null detaches).

hostFunctions.name: paged.movePage
hostFunctions.summary: Move a page to follow another (omit/null: to the front).

hostFunctions.name: paged.placePage
hostFunctions.summary: Put a page (an artboard) at [x, y] pt on the canvas (omit/null: its default slot).

hostFunctions.name: paged.symbols
hostFunctions.summary: The document's symbols: id, name, revision, bounds, 9-slice guides, instances.

hostFunctions.name: paged.createSymbol
hostFunctions.summary: Make a symbol from page items; with replace (default) they become an instance, which is selected. Returns the symbol id.

hostFunctions.name: paged.redefineSymbol
hostFunctions.summary: New artwork, name or 9-slice guides ([] removes) for a symbol; every instance follows.

hostFunctions.name: paged.placeSymbolInstance
hostFunctions.summary: Place an instance, its registration point at [x, y] page pt (omit: the page centre); returns its instance:<id> address.

hostFunctions.name: paged.breakSymbolLink
hostFunctions.summary: Break Link to Symbol: the instance becomes ordinary items; returns the new root's address.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteSymbol
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a symbol; its instances become ordinary items first.

hostFunctions.name: paged.expandAppearance
hostFunctions.summary: Expand Appearance: the item becomes what its live vector effects draw (engine ADR 1042).

hostFunctions.name: paged.createMaster
hostFunctions.summary: Create a master spread: one page of the given size, or a copy of another master.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteMaster
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a master no page applies.

hostFunctions.name: paged.renameMaster
hostFunctions.summary: Set (omit/null: clear) a master's name.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setPageOverrides
hostFunctions.summary: Set a page's (or master page's) override list: the master items it hides.

hostFunctions.name: paged.overrideMasterItems
hostFunctions.summary: Copy master items onto a page where the master draws them and hide the master's.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertItemHyperlink
hostFunctions.summary: Make a page item a hyperlink's source, to a URL or a page.

hostFunctions.name: paged.onMaster
hostFunctions.summary: Apply a mutation ({ op, args }) to a master spread's items.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setPageMetadata
hostFunctions.summary: Set or delete one plugin-metadata entry on a page (value: the JSON envelope).

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteElement
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a page item (kind:id address or bare self id).

hostFunctions.name: paged.dissolveGroup
hostFunctions.summary: Ungroup; members return to the group's paint slot.

hostFunctions.name: paged.moveFrame
hostFunctions.summary: Set a frame's affine placement transform.

hostFunctions.name: paged.resizeFrame
hostFunctions.summary: Set a frame's content-box bounds (re-paginating resize).

hostFunctions.name: paged.linkFrames
hostFunctions.summary: Thread fromId's overflow into the empty frame toId.

hostFunctions.name: paged.unlinkFrames
hostFunctions.summary: Break the text thread leaving a frame.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertLine
hostFunctions.summary: Insert a two-anchor open GraphicLine.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertOval
hostFunctions.summary: Insert an Oval.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertPath
hostFunctions.summary: Insert an arbitrary path; anchors = [{anchor:[x,y],left:[x,y],right:[x,y]}, …].

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathPointInsert
hostFunctions.summary: Insert an anchor into a path's flat PathPointArray at index.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathPointRemove
hostFunctions.summary: Remove the anchor at flat index.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathPointCurveType
hostFunctions.summary: Toggle an anchor between corner and smooth.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathPointSet
hostFunctions.summary: Write one Bezier handle (role = anchor|left|right).

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathOpenAt
hostFunctions.summary: Cut the path at the anchor at flat index.

hostFunctions.name: paged.outlineStroke
hostFunctions.summary: Replace the path with its stroke-expansion outline.

hostFunctions.name: paged.offsetPath
hostFunctions.summary: Inset (delta<0) / outset (delta>0) a path; compound paths keep their holes; side (both|left|right) offsets an open contour to one side.

hostFunctions.name: paged.simplifyPath
hostFunctions.summary: Re-express the path with fewer anchors within tolerance pt.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathfinderBoolean
hostFunctions.summary: Pathfinder boolean (kind = union|intersect|subtract|exclude).

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertField
hostFunctions.summary: Insert a field marker; fieldKind = "pageNumber" | "nextPageNumber" | { placeholder: { plugin, key, value? } } | { textVariable: { variableId } } (an instance of a text variable; InDesign keeps it).

hostFunctions.name: paged.createTextVariable
hostFunctions.summary: Define a custom text variable; returns textVariable:dTextVariablen<name>. Switch its value with paged.set(address, "textVariableContents", v) — every instance re-bakes.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteTextVariable
hostFunctions.summary: Remove a text variable definition (refused while an instance is in the text).

hostFunctions.name: paged.createXmlTag
hostFunctions.summary: Define an XML tag (color: a tag colour such as "Red").

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteXmlTag
hostFunctions.summary: Remove an XML tag (refused while an element uses it).

hostFunctions.name: paged.tagItem
hostFunctions.summary: Tag a page item or a story with an XML tag (a text frame's element tags its story); the tag and the root are made when missing.

hostFunctions.name: paged.untagItem
hostFunctions.summary: Remove the element tagging a page item or a story.

hostFunctions.name: paged.tagRange
hostFunctions.summary: Tag the story characters [start, end) with an XML tag (an untagged story is tagged Story first).

hostFunctions.name: paged.untagRange
hostFunctions.summary: Remove the element tagging a text range; the ranges inside it stay tagged.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setXmlAttribute
hostFunctions.summary: Set an XML element's attribute; no value removes it. label, maxLength and required are a template field's metadata.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setFieldValue
hostFunctions.summary: Update a placeholder field's cached display value (null ⇒ unresolved).

hostFunctions.name: paged.replaceImageBytes
hostFunctions.summary: Commit inline image bytes (number[] of u8) on a graphic frame; null clears.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertTable
hostFunctions.summary: Create a <Table> at the end of a story; spec = { rows, cols, headerRows?, footerRows?, columnWidths?, rowHeights? }. Returns the table id.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setRowHeight
hostFunctions.summary: Set/clear a table row height in pt.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setColumnWidth
hostFunctions.summary: Set/clear a table column width in pt.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertTableRow
hostFunctions.summary: Insert an empty body row at index.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteTable
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a whole table and its host paragraph; undo restores every cell.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteTableRow
hostFunctions.summary: Delete the body row at index.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertTableColumn
hostFunctions.summary: Insert an empty column at index.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteTableColumn
hostFunctions.summary: Delete the column at index.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertHeaderRow
hostFunctions.summary: Insert a header-band row.

hostFunctions.name: paged.removeHeaderRow
hostFunctions.summary: Remove the first header row.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertFooterRow
hostFunctions.summary: Insert a footer-band row.

hostFunctions.name: paged.removeFooterRow
hostFunctions.summary: Remove the last footer row.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setCellSpan
hostFunctions.summary: Set a cell's row/column span.

hostFunctions.name: paged.createParagraphStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Create a paragraph style; returns its selfId.

hostFunctions.name: paged.renameParagraphStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Rename a paragraph style.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteParagraphStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a paragraph style.

hostFunctions.name: paged.createCharacterStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Create a character style; returns its selfId.

hostFunctions.name: paged.renameCharacterStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Rename a character style.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteCharacterStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a character style.

hostFunctions.name: paged.createObjectStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Create an object style; returns its selfId.

hostFunctions.name: paged.renameObjectStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Rename an object style.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteObjectStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Delete an object style.

hostFunctions.name: paged.createCellStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Create a cell style; returns its selfId.

hostFunctions.name: paged.renameCellStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Rename a cell style.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteCellStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a cell style.

hostFunctions.name: paged.createTableStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Create a table style; returns its selfId.

hostFunctions.name: paged.renameTableStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Rename a table style.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteTableStyle
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a table style.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setStyleProperty
hostFunctions.summary: Set one property on a style definition (collection = paragraph|character|object|cell|table; path = a settablePaths name).

hostFunctions.name: paged.createNumberingList
hostFunctions.summary: Create a <NumberingList>; returns its id.

hostFunctions.name: paged.editNumberingList
hostFunctions.summary: Edit a <NumberingList>.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteNumberingList
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a <NumberingList>.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertSection
hostFunctions.summary: Anchor a <Section> at a page.

hostFunctions.name: paged.editSection
hostFunctions.summary: Edit a <Section>; prefix/start are tri-state (omit ⇒ leave, null ⇒ clear).

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteSection
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a <Section>.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setConditionVisible
hostFunctions.summary: Flip a condition's visibility.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setFlowGrowRule
hostFunctions.params: (storyId, grow, maxPages?, copyFrameOptions?, {master?, firstMaster?, evenMaster?, sectionStart?})
hostFunctions.summary: Let a story's frame chain grow: generated pages are added after its last frame's page while it oversets (InDesign's Smart Text Reflow), and removed when empty. copyFrameOptions gives generated frames the chain's frame options (a Word section's mode) instead of InDesign's defaults. The options pick a Word section's first / odd / even masters and an odd- or even-page start (a blank page goes in front when it lands wrong). grow=false clears the rule.

hostFunctions.name: paged.activateConditionSet
hostFunctions.summary: Activate one <ConditionSet> ("show only this set").

hostFunctions.name: paged.layerInsert
hostFunctions.summary: Append a layer at the zero-based stacking index.

hostFunctions.name: paged.layerRemove
hostFunctions.summary: Remove a layer.

hostFunctions.name: paged.layerMove
hostFunctions.summary: Reorder a layer to a new zero-based index.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertGuide
hostFunctions.summary: Insert a ruler guide (orientation = vertical|horizontal).

hostFunctions.name: paged.moveGuide
hostFunctions.summary: Move a guide along its perpendicular axis.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteGuide
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a guide.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setDocumentDefaults
hostFunctions.summary: Set the new-object fill/stroke/weight defaults (whole-triple).

hostFunctions.name: paged.setColorSettings
hostFunctions.summary: Replace the document colour-management settings.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setProofSetup
hostFunctions.summary: Soft-proofing configuration (profileName null turns proofing off).

hostFunctions.name: paged.importSwatchLibrary
hostFunctions.summary: Import an .ase swatch library (bytes = number[]) as one undoable op.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setInkSetting
hostFunctions.summary: Replace one ink's output-time settings.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setUseStandardLabForSpots
hostFunctions.summary: Prefer spots' Lab primary over their CMYK alternate in previews.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setPluginMetadata
hostFunctions.summary: Write one Label key/value pair on a leaf page item (value null deletes).

hostFunctions.name: paged.setDocumentMetadata
hostFunctions.summary: Write one document-scoped Label key/value pair (value null deletes); undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.batch
hostFunctions.summary: Apply an array of { op, args } mutation objects as ONE undoable step (bool). An array of ADR 323 object ops ({ op: "set", address, path, value }) returns the per-op results JSON ([{ ok } | { ok: false, code, reason }]), all-or-nothing in ONE undo step; when any op names a plugin: address, or is a typed command ({ op: "invoke", id, args, handle? }), the whole batch goes to the host's object registry (a Promise of the same JSON), so a command shares the one undo step with the sets.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setElementSelection
hostFunctions.summary: Replace the element selection with the parseable ids.

hostFunctions.name: paged.clearSelection
hostFunctions.summary: Clear the element selection.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setContentSelection
hostFunctions.summary: Set or clear the text caret/range.

hostFunctions.name: paged.reorderElement
hostFunctions.summary: Raise or lower an element in its parent's z-order. target = front | back | forward | backward | {index: n} (n = the final slot, 0 = backmost).

hostFunctions.name: paged.pasteInto
hostFunctions.summary: Nest an existing item inside a container frame.

hostFunctions.name: paged.releaseFrom
hostFunctions.summary: Lift a nested item back out of its container (inverse of pasteInto).

hostFunctions.name: paged.closePath
hostFunctions.summary: Close an open contour; subpath defaults to the whole path.

hostFunctions.name: paged.joinPaths
hostFunctions.summary: Weld two open paths into one.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathfinderDivide
hostFunctions.summary: Divide the selection into its planar regions.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathfinderTrim
hostFunctions.summary: Trim hidden parts of the lower shapes away.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathfinderMerge
hostFunctions.summary: Merge adjacent same-paint regions of the selection.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathfinderCrop
hostFunctions.summary: Crop the selection to the topmost shape.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathfinderOutline
hostFunctions.summary: Reduce the selection to its outlined edges.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathfinderMinusBack
hostFunctions.summary: Subtract the shapes behind from the frontmost one.

hostFunctions.name: paged.pathfinderFaces
hostFunctions.summary: Build ONE element from faces of the planar arrangement, united: mode keep = the named faces, remove = every other face (none named: every face, so the inputs unite). The result goes onto the topmost input covering a selected face; every other input is removed, so faces outside the selection are not kept. Face ids come from paged.planarRegions.

hostFunctions.name: paged.planarRegions
hostFunctions.summary: The planar arrangement of the named paths: found, faces (each with an id), inputCount, complete, reason. With a point, only the face under it. This is how a script names a face for pathfinderFaces.

hostFunctions.name: paged.applyOpacityMask
hostFunctions.summary: Mask one element with another.

hostFunctions.name: paged.releaseOpacityMask
hostFunctions.summary: Remove an element's opacity mask.

hostFunctions.name: paged.attachTextToPath
hostFunctions.summary: Run a story along a path.

hostFunctions.name: paged.detachTextFromPath
hostFunctions.summary: Take a story back off its path.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertAnchoredFrame
hostFunctions.summary: Anchor a frame in the text at a story offset; with imageUri the frame is created holding that image.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertHyperlink
hostFunctions.summary: Make a character range a clickable link. Read the result with paged.collection("hyperlinks") — paged.links() is the placed-asset list, not this.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteHyperlink
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a hyperlink (any origin) by its id from paged.collection("hyperlinks"): its text stops linking, and its URL or page destination goes when nothing else uses it.

hostFunctions.name: paged.editHyperlink
hostFunctions.summary: Rename a hyperlink or send it to a new URL or page (pageId wins); an empty name clears it.

hostFunctions.name: paged.updateTableOfContents
hostFunctions.summary: Update Table of Contents: rewrite a TOC story (one bound to a TOC style) from its style over the current layout — the title, then one paragraph per heading with its page number. Until then it prints the text it holds.

hostFunctions.name: paged.generateIndex
hostFunctions.summary: Generate Index: write the document's index into a story (replacing its text) from its topics and page references over the current layout — the title, a heading per letter, each topic with its pages and See references. Index styles the document lacks are created.

hostFunctions.name: paged.updateCrossReferences
hostFunctions.summary: Update Cross-References: rewrite a cross-reference's text (every one's without an id) from its format and its destination paragraph; the page number is always live.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertFootnote
hostFunctions.summary: Insert a footnote at a story offset: its reference there, and the note (its number, the separator, then text). Returns the note's id; read the notes with paged.collection("footnotes").

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteFootnote
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a footnote: its reference and its note. Undo puts both back as they were.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertNote
hostFunctions.summary: Insert an editorial note at a story offset: its place there (one character that prints nothing) and its text, paragraphs separated by \r; user and date are what it records as its author and dates. Returns the note's id; read the notes with paged.collection("notes").

hostFunctions.name: paged.editNote
hostFunctions.summary: Rewrite an editorial note's text; date becomes its modification date.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteNote
hostFunctions.summary: Delete an editorial note and its place in the text. Undo puts it back as it was.

hostFunctions.name: paged.acceptTrackedChange
hostFunctions.summary: Accept a tracked deletion at its story offset (paged.collection("trackedChanges")): the text stays deleted. Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.rejectTrackedChange
hostFunctions.summary: Reject a tracked deletion at its story offset: its text comes back where it stood, as InDesign rejects one. Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.recordChange
hostFunctions.params: (storyId, start, end, {kind, id?, author?, date?, beforeCharacterStyle?, beforeParagraphStyle?}, paragraph?)
hostFunctions.summary: Record a tracked change (insert, delete, format, paraProps, insertMark, deleteMark) over story chars [start, end), or on a paragraph for the paragraph kinds: what an importer writes for Word's revisions. Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.acceptChange
hostFunctions.summary: Accept a tracked change by id, every change by an author, or all (in one story when storyId is set). One undo step.

hostFunctions.name: paged.rejectChange
hostFunctions.summary: Reject a tracked change by id, an author's, or all: insertions go, deletions stay, formatting goes back. One undo step.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertComment
hostFunctions.params: (storyId, start, end, {text, id?, author?, initials?, date?})
hostFunctions.summary: A comment on story chars [start, end) (paged.collection("comments")). Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.replyComment
hostFunctions.summary: Reply to a comment; the reply joins its thread. Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.resolveComment
hostFunctions.summary: Resolve (or, with false, reopen) a comment's thread. Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteComment
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a comment; a thread's first comment takes its replies and its range. Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.editComment
hostFunctions.summary: Rewrite a comment's text. Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.find
hostFunctions.params: (text, {storyId?, mode?, matchCase?, wholeWord?, paragraphStyle?, characterStyle?, limit?})
hostFunctions.summary: Find text (literal, Word wildcards or a regex; ^p ^t ^l ^m work in every mode): a JSON array of hits with story, caret and character ranges and context.

hostFunctions.name: paged.findReplace
hostFunctions.summary: Replace the first hit, or every hit, of a find; ^p ^t ^l ^& and $1 work in the replacement. One undo step.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setListLevel
hostFunctions.summary: Move the paragraphs touching story chars [start, end) to a list level 1–9, or by a delta (Tab / Shift+Tab). Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.restartNumbering
hostFunctions.summary: Restart the list count at the paragraphs touching [start, end) (or continue it). Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.setStyleBasedOn
hostFunctions.summary: Re-parent a style; refused when it would inherit from itself. Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.updateFields
hostFunctions.summary: Word's F9: recompute the Word fields' results (every story's, one story's, or the one field at a story offset) over the current layout; DATE and TIME read now (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). One undo step; refused when nothing changes.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertTextAnchor
hostFunctions.summary: Word's Insert Bookmark: a named text destination at a story offset, which REF and PAGEREF fields and cross-references name. Returns its id.

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteTextAnchor
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a bookmark (a text destination). Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertCrossReference
hostFunctions.summary: Word's Insert Cross-reference: a REF or PAGEREF field with its result, to a bookmark or to a paragraph (which gets a hidden _Ref bookmark). One undo step.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertTableOfContents
hostFunctions.params: (storyId, offset, [{style, level}], {title?, tocStyleName?, pageNumbers?, leader?, tabPosition?})
hostFunctions.summary: Word's Insert Table of Contents: the TOC style and TOC 1… entry styles (right tab with a leader) when missing, and the entries with their page numbers in paragraphs of their own at the caret. paged.updateTableOfContents rewrites them in place. One undo step.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertIndexMarker
hostFunctions.summary: Word's Mark Entry: an index marker for a topic path in the paragraph at a story offset; missing topics are created. paged.generateIndex lists it. Undoable.

hostFunctions.name: paged.convertNoteToText
hostFunctions.summary: Convert to Text: an editorial note's place becomes a space and the note's text, its paragraphs the story's.

hostFunctions.name: paged.createBookmark
hostFunctions.summary: New Bookmark: to a page (through a page destination of its own) or an existing destination, under a bookmark or at the top level, at an index among its siblings. Returns the bookmark's id; read them with paged.collection("bookmarks").

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteBookmark
hostFunctions.summary: Delete a bookmark and the bookmarks under it, and the page destinations nothing else goes to. Undo puts them back.

hostFunctions.name: paged.renameBookmark
hostFunctions.summary: Rename a bookmark.

hostFunctions.name: paged.insertEndnote
hostFunctions.summary: Insert an endnote at a story offset: its reference there and its range in the endnote story, after the note before it, as InDesign writes one. The first endnote makes the endnote story on a page of its own. Returns the endnote's id; read them with paged.collection("endnotes").

hostFunctions.name: paged.deleteEndnote
hostFunctions.summary: Delete an endnote: its reference and its range. Undo puts both back as they were.

hostFunctions.name: paged.convertFootnoteToEndnote
hostFunctions.summary: Convert a footnote to an endnote: the footnote goes and an endnote of its text takes its reference's place. Returns the endnote's id.

hostFunctions.name: paged.moveBookmark
hostFunctions.summary: Move a bookmark with the bookmarks under it: under another bookmark (the top level for null), at an index among its siblings.

hostFunctions.summary: Rename a layer.

idGrammar.note: A text frame. Same scheme: rectangle:/oval:/polygon:/graphicLine:/group:.
A rectangle (graphic frame).
An oval.
A polygon or open path.
A graphic line.
A group. `paged.set("group:<id>", "groupTransform", [a,b,c,d,tx,ty])` moves it as a unit.
Any page item, kind unknown (alias). paged.address / paged.query resolve it to the kind-specific form.
A character range within a story (half-open). storyId comes from paged.stories()[].selfId. Alias: story:<storyId>@<start>..<end>.
The document itself.
A body page, by its Self id (paged.pages()[].selfId), or page:#<n> for the n-th page (1-based).
A spread, by its Self id.
A layer, by its Self id (paged.layers()).
A master spread. `master:<id> > textFrame:<id>` names an item on it.
A story, by its Self id.
A text field anchored at a story character offset (paged.placeholders / RequestDocumentPlaceholders).
A table, by its Self id (unique per document).
A table cell, zero-based row and column.
A style; family is paragraph | character | object | cell | table. The display name is accepted in place of the Self id.
A colour or swatch, by its Self id.
A gradient, by its Self id.
A colour group.
A numbering list.
A ruler guide.
A text condition.
A condition set.
A numbering section.
A hyperlink.
A text variable, by its Self id (the designmap's TextVariable). Its name is accepted in a selector: textVariable[name="Running Head"].
An object a plugin owns. Opaque to core and carried through unchanged.
A batch handle bound earlier in the same batch.
A symbol instance (engine ADR 1039): a placed reference to a symbol definition.

constraints: Scripts run in Boa (pure ECMAScript), NOT Node: no require/import, fetch, fs, setTimeout, or network. Use only paged.* and console.*.

Reads return JSON STRINGS, not live values: JSON.parse(paged.selection()/tree()/stories()/pages()/…) before you index. Parsed elements are { kind, id } objects — address one as the string `${kind}:${id}` (e.g. textFrame:u3) for paged.set / inspect / get.

Property writes (paged.set) return a boolean: true = applied, false = rejected (unknown id/path, bad value, or a failed precondition). The structural insert fns are the exception — see below. Always check the result and adapt.
Writes go through the editor's Operation channel, so paged.undo()/paged.redo() work exactly as in the UI.
Runtime budgets: ~10M loop iterations, recursion depth 512, and a ~2s wall-clock checked at every host call. Runaway scripts are aborted (non-catchable).

insertFrame/insertTextFrame return the new element's kind:id address (and auto-select it); insertPage returns the new page's selfId. Pass the returned id straight to paged.set / placeImage / insertText (use paged.pages() for a page id, paged.stories() for the minted story).
Bounds are page-local points in [top, left, bottom, right] order. The document works in points (1/72 inch).

elements.name: TextFrame
elements.summary: A frame that pours a story. Geometry + fill/stroke like any page item, plus text-frame preferences (columns, inset, vertical justification).

attributes.name: Self
attributes.summary: The element's IDML id; how everything references it.

attributes.name: ParentStory
attributes.summary: The story this frame pours; the threading link, not a settable property.

elements.name: Rectangle
elements.summary: A rectangular graphic frame — a vector shape that can also hold a placed image.

elements.name: Polygon
elements.summary: An arbitrary closed vector shape; may carry multiple GeometryPathType contours (compound paths).

elements.name: GraphicLine
elements.summary: A straight or curved open path.

elements.name: Group
elements.summary: A grouping container that transforms its children as a unit.

attributes.name: ItemTransform
attributes.summary: The group's affine transform, applied to all children.

elements.name: Layer
elements.summary: A document layer; controls visibility, lock, and print state for the items assigned to it.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.summary: Layer name. Changed by the `layerSetName` mutation, not `paged.set` — a layer has no element address.

attributes.name: Visible
attributes.summary: Whether the layer's items render. Changed by `layerSetVisible`.

attributes.name: Locked
attributes.summary: Whether the layer's items are editable. Changed by `layerSetLocked`. NOTE: enforced at hit-test only — a dispatched mutation is not blocked by it.

attributes.name: Printable
attributes.summary: Whether the layer prints/exports. Changed by `layerSetPrintable`.

elements.name: Page
elements.summary: A single page within a spread.

attributes.name: Self
attributes.summary: Element id; the target for paged.insertTextFrame / insertFrame.

attributes.name: GeometricBounds
attributes.summary: Page bounds in the spread's coordinate space.

elements.name: Spread
elements.summary: A spread: one or more pages laid out together, with its own page-item stacking order.

attributes.name: ItemTransform
attributes.summary: The spread's transform in pasteboard space.

elements.name: Story
elements.summary: A flow of text, independent of the frame(s) that pour it. Edited by character offset, not by frame.

attributes.name: Self
attributes.summary: Story id; the target for paged.insertText / deleteRange / applyStyle.

elements.name: ParagraphStyleRange
elements.summary: A run of paragraphs sharing a paragraph style and overrides, inside a story.

attributes.name: AppliedParagraphStyle
attributes.summary: The paragraph style applied to the range.

elements.name: CharacterStyleRange
elements.summary: A run of characters sharing a character style and overrides, inside a paragraph.

attributes.name: AppliedCharacterStyle
attributes.summary: The character style applied to the range.
